# unifi Provider

Manage a UniFi OS console (Network app today; Protect later) as code. Connects to a single console over its local API surfaces. A local UniFi OS admin account is effectively required; an Integration API key unlocks the official API where firmware supports it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    unifi = {
      source = "dovys/unifi"
    }
  }
}

# A local UniFi OS admin account is effectively required (cloud/SSO accounts
# that force 2FA are rejected). An Integration API key is optional and unlocks
# the official API where firmware supports it. All fields also read from
# environment variables (UNIFI_HOST, UNIFI_USERNAME, UNIFI_PASSWORD, …).
provider "unifi" {
  host     = "https://192.0.2.1"
  username = var.unifi_username
  password = var.unifi_password
  api_key  = var.unifi_api_key

  # UniFi consoles ship self-signed certs on local IPs.
  allow_insecure = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `allow_insecure` (Boolean) Skip TLS certificate verification. UniFi consoles ship self-signed certs on local IPs, so this is commonly needed against a LAN console. Defaults to `false`. Env: `UNIFI_INSECURE`.
- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Integration API key (Network → Settings → Control Plane → Integrations). Console-wide and owner-level — treat as admin-equivalent. Env: `UNIFI_API_KEY`.
- `host` (String) Console base URL or host, e.g. `https://192.0.2.1` or `unifi.example.com`. A bare host is assumed `https://`. Env: `UNIFI_HOST`.
- `max_retries` (Number) Number of times to retry a request that returns HTTP 429 (rate limited). Defaults to `3`. Env: `UNIFI_MAX_RETRIES`.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password for `username`. Env: `UNIFI_PASSWORD`.
- `site` (String) Site slug to manage (the internal reference, e.g. `default`). Defaults to `default`. Env: `UNIFI_SITE`.
- `timeout` (String) Per-request timeout as a Go duration (e.g. `60s`, `2m`). Defaults to `60s`. Env: `UNIFI_TIMEOUT`.
- `username` (String) Local UniFi OS admin username (not a cloud/SSO account). Required together with `password`. Env: `UNIFI_USERNAME`.
